name:
YO-KAI WATCH® 2:
Bony Spirits
description:
If you purchase the downloadable version of YO-KAI WATCH 2: Bony Spirits, you can get a special in-game item that lets you encounter Robonyan F in the game and have a chance to befriend him.

A sinister force has sparked a war between two Yo-kai factions, Bony Spirits and Fleshy Souls, causing chaos throughout the world. Befriend more than 350 new and returning Yo-kai, each with unique personalities, and team up with the heroic cat Yo-kai Hovernyan to travel back in time and save Springdale!

Supports 2 Players online and 4 Players via Local Play
disclaimer:
*Yo-kai Watch™ YO-MOTION medals and Yo-kai Watch Model Zero™ watch each sold separately.

*Additional games and systems required for multiplayer; sold separately. Wireless Internet access required for online features. For more info, go to support.nintendo.com.

Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or
“Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “Sleep Mode.”

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
